name: dispel evil and good
lore:
### On the Rite of Abjuration: *Dispel Evil and Good*

To cast this rite is to become a lighthouse amidst a storm of extraplanar chaos. As the incantation peaks, the air crystallizes into a shimmering, opalescent shroud. To the caster, the Weave feels like a taut silver cord vibrating with celestial resonance—a cold, purifying pressure that demands absolute focus. When unleashed, the magic manifests as a flash of "un-light" that unravels the tether between the target and this world, whether they be fiend or celestial.

Legend attributes its origin to Saint Elara the Silent. During the *Night of Weeping Shadows*, she stood before a breach in the Firmament. She uttered no word, only a single, resonant hum that vibrated through the very stones. The invading entities did not die; they simply dissolved into the ether, as if the laws of reality had reconsidered their presence. Since then, the spell has served as the ultimate threshold, reminding the denizens of the Outer Planes that this world belongs to its own.
